theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (b : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Θ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (D : Set (Rn n)) (B₀ : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Θ₀ : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (P₀ : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (c : Rn ℓ) (s : ℝ), IsOpen D → ContinuousOn (fun p : Rn n × (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) × (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) => b p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) (D ×ˢ univ) → ContinuousOn Θ D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 v D → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ D → ∫ x in D, b x (fderiv ℝ v x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in D, Θ x (fderiv ℝ ζ x)) → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∫ x, B₀ P₀ (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = 0) → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∫ x, Θ₀ (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => s • (v x - c - P₀ x)) D ∧ (∀ x ∈ D, fderiv ℝ (fun x => s • (v x - c - P₀ x)) x = s • (fderiv ℝ v x - P₀)) ∧ ∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ D → ∫ x in D, b x (fderiv ℝ (fun x => s • (v x - c - P₀ x)) x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in D, (s • ((Θ x - Θ₀) - (b x P₀ - B₀ P₀))) (fderiv ℝ ζ x)
